title: Nextera DNA Flex Library Prep: Tagment DNA
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Vortex reagents and load rack
steps.instruction: Vortex the BLT and TB1 reagents vigorously for 10 seconds, then place BLT in tube‑rack well B1 and TB1 in well C1, and resume the protocol.

steps.title: Preprogram thermocycler
steps.instruction: Program the thermocycler with the TAG program parameters as described in the Nextera DNA Flex kit manual.

steps.title: Arrange deck and labware
steps.instruction: Place a 1.5 ml Eppendorf tuberack in slot 2 with the following tubes: A1‑B1 – empty 1.5 ml snap‑cap tubes for mastermix (one tube per 48 samples); A2‑B2 – 0.5 ml false‑bottom tubes containing BLT (one tube per 48 samples); A3‑B3 – 0.5 ml false‑bottom tubes containing TB1 (one tube per 48 samples). If using a P50 multi‑channel pipette, place 200 µl PCR strips in slot 3, column 1 of the strip containing an empty mastermix strip. Also place the 300 µl Opentrons tipracks on the deck as required for the P50 pipette.

steps.title: Enter pipette mount settings
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons protocol app, input the mount side for the P50 single‑channel pipette, indicate whether a P50 multi‑channel pipette will be used, specify its mount side if applicable, and enter the number of samples to process.

steps.title: Download protocol
steps.instruction: Download the generated protocol file from the Opentrons app.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol file into the Opentrons OT‑2 app.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2 app, calibrate the deck labware, tip racks, and the P50 pipette according to the app’s calibration procedure.

steps.title: Start the run
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 app to execute the tagmentation protocol.
